newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska governor outlines legislative agenda.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska governor outlines legislative agenda.

text.p: Nebraska Gov. Ben Nelson unveiled this week legislative initiatives he plans to introduce next month to reduce income and property taxes and enhance economic development initiatives.

Nelson plans to propose an income tax cut during his budget and state of the state address Jan. 15, according to a spokesman. The tax cut would be spurred by an anticipated surplus in the current fiscal year budget, the spokesman said.

The governor also plans to propose a local option property tax relief act that would give local taxpayers the option, through the referendum process, to create a local income tax inorder to reduce local property taxes.
Other legislative proposals on Nelson's agenda include linking unemployed workers to jobs, job training, expanded international trade and tourism marketing intiatives.
